title: Photo Editing App
scenario: A free app says it can make your photo look perfect but asks for full camera roll access.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Photo Editing App: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Limit app permissions, especially photo and contact access.
